headline: CMPDI shares worth ₹9,500 crore exit lock-in period
hook: Lock-in expiry hits CMPDI shares today
summary: Shares of Central Mine Planning & Design Institute (CMPDI) worth over ₹9,500 crore have become eligible for trading following the expiry of the mandatory lock-in period. This release increases the floating stock available in the market. Retail investors should note that increased supply can lead to heightened price volatility in the near term. The stock may face selling pressure as some pre-IPO investors look to exit their positions.
why_it_matters: Increased share supply may trigger short-term price volatility
winners_losers: Pre-IPO investors gain / retail holders face volatility

headline: Shares worth $14 billion across 91 companies set to exit lock-in by December
hook: $14 billion in locked shares unlock soon
summary: Lock-in periods for shares in 91 companies will expire over the next three months, releasing approximately $14 billion worth of stock into the market. This includes the release of 464 million shares in the Central Mine Planning & Design Institute. Indian retail investors holding shares in these companies should assess potential selling pressure from pre-IPO investors as restrictions lift through November and December. Increased supply from these unlocks could weigh on near-term stock prices.
whats_next: Lock-in expiry dates through November and December
why_it_matters: Potential selling pressure could weigh on near-term prices.
winners_losers: Pre-IPO investors gain / retail holders face pressure

headline: CMPDI submits SEBI depositories and participants compliance certificate
summary: Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited has submitted a regulatory certificate pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine procedural filing required for listed entities regarding depository operations. There is no direct financial impact or operational shift reported in this disclosure. Indian retail investors have no actionable financial takeaways from this administrative filing.
why_it_matters: Routine paperwork with zero impact on stock price or operations.
